places.name: Arkansas River
places.note: The herd moves toward it on good grass; Call and Deets ride ahead by moonlight to inspect its swift crossing.

places.raw_name: the herd's camp south of the Arkansas
places.name: Kansas
places.note: West of the grasshopper damage a cow gores Mouse fatally; next morning Newt breakfasts with Gus and Lorena on the open plain.
places.location_hint: southern Kansas plains, a few miles south of the Arkansas River, not far from Dodge City

places.name: Rio Grande
places.note: Call notes it rises in the same mountains as the Arkansas; Deets feels homesick for its warm shallow water.

places.name: Colorado
places.note: Call gazes upriver toward it, thinking Blue Duck is somewhere up there.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Newt had worried since leaving it that Lorena blamed him; Deets longs for home.

places.name: Canada
places.note: Augustus jokes Po Campo means to walk all the way there.

places.name: Ogallala
places.note: The town where Gus's other woman lives; Lorena means to win him before they arrive.

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Call thinks Jake came back there only to lean on them.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande

places.name: Dodge City
places.note: Not far off; Call guesses Jake, whose horse's track Deets found, may be heading there to gamble.

groups.label: Hat Creek herd
groups.hint: a few miles south of the Arkansas River crossing, not far from Dodge City

groups.label: Augustus and Lorena
groups.hint: tent camp near the herd, a few miles south of the Arkansas River
